content:
Apple's newly appointed CEO has just opened a social media account on X, with the handle @johnternus. His self-introduction is very simple, simply "CEO", and his first post also only says "hello".

Today marks the first day of Ternus officially taking office, and outgoing Tim Cook will transition to the role of Executive Chairman.

Apple's relationship with social media is generally quite interesting. As a company, Apple operates the @apple X account, but apart from sponsored advertisements, it has not posted any other content. However, executives such as former CEO Tim Cook and Senior Vice President of Marketing Greg Jozwiak all have public personal accounts.

We don't yet know what content Ternus will post on X, but it can be expected that his approach will be similar to Cook's account management style, including announcing new products and occasionally making statements on various company initiatives.

It is anticipated that by next Wednesday, Apple will hold its autumn major product launch event, where Ternus's account will be very active, with new iPhones and Apple Watches expected to be unveiled.

Before being promoted to CEO, Ternus served as Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering for five years, and his overall career at Apple spans twenty-five years. He is widely regarded by outsiders as a more product-oriented CEO compared to the operations-focused outgoing CEO Cook.
